apps.name: K3 Browser
apps.subtitle: Native WKWebView browser baseline
apps.localizedDescription: Minimal native iOS WKWebView browser for sideloading. No DDG entitlements, no extensions, no app groups. Includes URL/search bar, back/forward/reload, share sheet, progress indicator, persistent WKWebsiteDataStore.
apps.versionDescription: Initial K3Browser WKWebView baseline for Feather/KSign sideloading.
